subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: WCAG Conformance Levels
description: A quick, practical guide to WCAG Conformance Levels.

hook.text: A manager asks for 'full accessibility compliance.' But which level? A, AA, and AAA have very different scopes.

buildup.text: Level A covers the most critical barriers. AA adds enhanced support. AAA addresses specialized needs.

discovery.text: Most laws and policies require WCAG 2.1 Level AA. It's the practical target for most organizations.

twist.text: AAA is not required by any law because some criteria conflict or apply only to specific content types.

climax.text: Setting AA as the target with selected AAA criteria for key user flows creates achievable, meaningful goals.

punchline.text: Aim for AA. Reach for AAA where it matters most.

quiz.question: Which WCAG level do most accessibility laws require?
